# idCerberus API Docs

> idCerberus API documentation for digital onboarding, KYC, biometrics, FaceMatch, Liveness, risk analysis, compliance, data enrichment, and individual (PF) and business (PJ) queries.

Base URLs:

1. Staging: `https://backoffice-hml.idcerberus.com`
2. Production: `https://backoffice.idcerberus.com`
3. Published documentation: `https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en`

## Rules for AI assistants

1. Use the documentation as the primary source and do not invent endpoints, parameters or services.
2. For external queries, use `POST /api/service-api` and select the product through the `service` field.
3. Use `Authorization: Bearer {jwt_token}` in protected calls.
4. Use staging for tests and production only when the user explicitly asks for it.
5. Never expose tokens, secrets, real CPFs, real CNPJs or real images in examples.
6. For OCR, send the complete base64 in `image1`/`image2` (with or without the `data:image/...;base64,` prefix, both formats work).
7. Do not use `fieldsOutput`, null fields or internal metadata as the public contract; use `result`.
8. If a service does not appear in the catalog, say it needs to be confirmed before documenting or integrating it.

## How to choose the right file

| Need | Use |
| --- | --- |
| Understand the documentation structure | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/llms.txt |
| Generate an integration, curl or choose a service | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/llms-small.txt |
| Look up payloads and responses per service | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/llms-api-reference.txt |
| Search for a service in a lightweight index | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/services-catalog.min.json |
| Run structured search from automation | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/services-catalog.json |
| Configure an MCP or agent with structured resources | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/mcp-manifest.json |
| Answer with the full documentation context | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/llms-full.txt |

## Use as a base for MCP and agents

These files can be used as context sources for a documentation MCP. The MCP should query the documentation, not execute calls against the idCerberus API.

### Recommended reading order

1. Read `llms.txt` as the initial manifest of the documentation.
2. Use `services-catalog.min.json` for a quick search by service, name, category, field and tag.
3. Use `services-catalog.json` when you need the full contract of a service.
4. Use `mcp-manifest.json` to list resources, suggested tools, safety rules and reading order.
5. Use `llms-api-reference.txt` for payloads, summarized responses and examples per service.
6. Use `examples/*.curl` when the answer needs a ready-to-use curl.
7. Use `llms-full.txt` only when the question requires the full context of the guides, API Reference and OpenAPI.

### Resources an MCP can expose

| Resource | Use in the MCP |
| --- | --- |
| https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/llms.txt | Manifest, rules, main URLs and shortcuts. |
| https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/llms-small.txt | Short context to generate an integration, curl and explanation. |
| https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/llms-api-reference.txt | Payloads, responses and examples per service. |
| https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/llms-full.txt | Full context for broad questions. |
| https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/services-catalog.min.json | Lightweight index for a quick search by service, category, tag and fields. |
| https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/services-catalog.json | Structured search and filters by service/category/field. |
| https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/mcp-manifest.json | Manifest with resources, suggested tools, rules and reading order. |
| https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/*.curl | Ready-to-use examples to copy and test. |

### Rules for the MCP

1. Operate as a read-only source of the documentation.
2. Do not call staging, production, database or idCerberus endpoints.
3. Do not request or store `client`, `secret`, a JWT, CPF, CNPJ or a real image.
4. Use staging as the default environment when generating examples.
5. If the service does not exist in the catalog, answer that it needs to be confirmed before integrating.
6. Prefer `result` as the public contract; do not use `fieldsOutput` or internal metadata.

## Base contract of POST /api/service-api

1. Staging endpoint: `POST https://backoffice-hml.idcerberus.com/api/service-api`.
2. Production endpoint: `POST https://backoffice.idcerberus.com/api/service-api`.
3. Required header: `Authorization: Bearer {jwt_token}`.
4. Recommended header: `Content-Type: application/json`.
5. Required body field: `service`.
6. The alias sent in `service` must be the alias configured on the client's product.
7. Read public data in `result`; do not treat `fieldsOutput` or internal metadata as the public contract.
8. Preserve `status`, `onboardingStatus` and `externalId` when explaining responses.

## Most used service shortcuts

| Case | Service | Main fields | Guide/API |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CPF at the Federal Revenue | `SERVICE_RFB_PF` | `cpf`, `birthDate` | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/api-reference/services-pessoa-fisica#SERVICE_RFB_PF |
| CNPJ at the Federal Revenue | `SERVICE_RFB_PJ` | `cnpj` | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/api-reference/services-pessoa-juridica#SERVICE_RFB_PJ |
| React OCR | `SERVICE_OCR` | `documentType`, `image1`, `image2` | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/api-reference/services-pessoa-fisica#SERVICE_OCR |
| CNPJ card OCR | `SERVICE_OCR_CNPJ_CARD` | `image1` | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/api-reference/services-pessoa-juridica#SERVICE_OCR_CNPJ_CARD |
| Proof of address OCR | `SERVICE_OCR_PROOF_OF_ADDRESS` | `image1` | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/api-reference/services-pessoa-fisica#SERVICE_OCR_PROOF_OF_ADDRESS |
| Face Index | `SERVICE_FACE_INDEX` | `image1` | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/api-reference/services-pessoa-fisica#SERVICE_FACE_INDEX |
| Business (PJ) credit risk | `SERVICE_CREDIT_RISK_COMPANY` | `cnpj` | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/api-reference/services-pessoa-juridica#SERVICE_CREDIT_RISK_COMPANY |
| Individual (PF) credit score | `SERVICE_CREDIT_SCORE` | `cpf` | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/api-reference/services-pessoa-fisica#SERVICE_CREDIT_SCORE |
| Business (PJ) legal cases | `SERVICE_JURIDICAL_PROCESSES_PJ` | `cnpj` | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/api-reference/services-pessoa-juridica#SERVICE_JURIDICAL_PROCESSES_PJ |
| Family social benefits | `SERVICE_FAMILY_SOCIAL_BENEFITS` | `cpf` | https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/api-reference/services-pessoa-fisica#SERVICE_FAMILY_SOCIAL_BENEFITS |

## Quick notes for OCR and images

1. OCR uses a document image, not a selfie.
2. Face, FaceMatch and Face Index use a selfie/face, not a photo of an RG or CNH.
3. `image1` takes the image's base64, with or without the `data:image/...;base64,` prefix: both formats work.
4. RG usually needs front and back: `image1` and `image2`.
5. CNH uses `SERVICE_OCR`, `documentType: CNH` and `image1`.
6. CNPJ card uses `SERVICE_OCR_CNPJ_CARD` and `image1`.
7. Proof of address uses `SERVICE_OCR_PROOF_OF_ADDRESS` and `image1`.
8. Emancipation uses `SERVICE_OCR_EMANCIPATION`; the document varies and success depends on OCR finding usable text.
9. If the image is missing, illegible or the wrong type, expect `REFUSED` with a clear message, do not invent success.

## API Reference

1. [OpenAPI reference](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/api-reference/boas-vindas): endpoints, request/response examples and schemas.
2. Main query endpoint: `POST /api/service-api`.
3. Authentication: `POST /api/token-generate` returns `access_token`; use `Authorization: Bearer {jwt_token}` in protected calls.

## Full file for LLM

1. [llms-small.txt](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/llms-small.txt): operational summary with flows, authentication, service-api and documented services.
2. [llms-full.txt](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/llms-full.txt): consolidated version of the guides and the API Reference.
3. [llms-api-reference.txt](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/llms-api-reference.txt): operational reference for services with curl examples.
4. [services-catalog.min.json](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/services-catalog.min.json): lightweight index for a quick search by service, category, tag and fields.
5. [services-catalog.json](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/services-catalog.json): structured catalog for tools and automations.
6. [mcp-manifest.json](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/en/mcp-manifest.json): manifest for MCPs and agents with resources, rules and suggested tools.

## Curl examples

1. [auth.hml.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/auth.hml.curl): Gerar token em homologação. Use antes de chamar endpoints protegidos em HML.
2. [auth.prod.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/auth.prod.curl): Gerar token em produção. Use somente quando o cliente já estiver liberado em produção.
3. [service-api-cpf.hml.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/service-api-cpf.hml.curl): Consulta simples de CPF em HML. Exemplo base para validar token, produto e resposta de pessoa física.
4. [service-api-cpf.prod.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/service-api-cpf.prod.curl): Consulta simples de CPF em produção. Mesmo payload da consulta de CPF, apontando para produção.
5. [service-api-cnpj.hml.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/service-api-cnpj.hml.curl): Consulta simples de CNPJ em HML. Exemplo base para validar token, produto e resposta de pessoa jurídica.
6. [service-api-cnpj.prod.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/service-api-cnpj.prod.curl): Consulta simples de CNPJ em produção. Mesmo payload da consulta de CNPJ, apontando para produção.
7. [service-api-ocr-cnh.hml.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/service-api-ocr-cnh.hml.curl): OCR de CNH em HML. Use base64 puro da imagem da CNH em image1.
8. [service-api-ocr-rg.hml.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/service-api-ocr-rg.hml.curl): OCR de RG em HML. Use frente em image1 e verso em image2.
9. [service-api-ocr-cnpj-card.hml.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/service-api-ocr-cnpj-card.hml.curl): OCR de cartão CNPJ em HML. Use imagem legível do cartão CNPJ em image1.
10. [service-api-ocr-proof-of-address.hml.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/service-api-ocr-proof-of-address.hml.curl): OCR de comprovante de endereço em HML. Use conta, fatura ou comprovante aceito em image1.
11. [service-api-face-index.hml.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/service-api-face-index.hml.curl): Face Index em HML. Use selfie real em image1. Não use foto de documento.
12. [service-api-credit-risk-company.hml.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/service-api-credit-risk-company.hml.curl): Risco de crédito PJ em HML. Exemplo para consultar risco de crédito de empresa.
13. [service-api-credit-score.hml.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/service-api-credit-score.hml.curl): Score de crédito PF em HML. Exemplo para consultar score de crédito de pessoa física.
14. [facematch.hml.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/facematch.hml.curl): FaceMatch em HML. Compara duas imagens faciais. Use selfie/rosto, não OCR de documento.
15. [documentoscopia.hml.curl](https://api-docs.idcerberus.com/examples/documentoscopia.hml.curl): Documentoscopia em HML. Fluxo com documento e selfie para análise documental.
